fixes: Make the two piles the hero and the comparison. Drop the camera to ledge height, push in so the two reams fill the lower third, set them a hand's width apart side by side on one depth plane. Give the kraft wrapper creases, a torn corner on the loose top block and a soft violet contact shadow where each pile meets the walnut.

Make the chamber clearly local government and finish the furniture: tufted leather chair backs with piping, walnut grain, rails and a modesty panel on the dais, and a council chamber cue in the empty upper violet with no legible text (a pendant bank, a blank seal medallion, plain flag poles).
